designDecisions.decision: Created shaded glazed southern openings, deep roof overhangs, a protected entry, and sheltered outdoor living appropriate to an assumed hot-humid Caribbean climate.
designDecisions.limitation: Wind, corrosion, thermal, drainage, hurricane, and weather-performance certification are not modeled.

designDecisions.decision: Constructed a covered terrace-end kitchen/bar counter zone with seating and direct adjacency to the indoor service wing.
designDecisions.limitation: Appliances, plumbing, extraction, smoke control, and food-service equipment are not implemented.

designDecisions.decision: Assumed a south-facing water view and located living, terrace, pool, and lounge toward it while keeping entry on the north side.
designDecisions.limitation: No surveyed shoreline, flood elevation, setbacks, terrain, coastal access, or marine engineering is represented.

designDecisions.decision: Established a legible sequence from arrival to living hall to sheltered terrace and separated private and service volumes from the central entertaining space.
designDecisions.limitation: The wing shells are not subdivided into verified individual bedrooms, baths, pantry, or utility rooms.

designDecisions.decision: Built a genuine recessed door opening, solid door, approach plate, posts, and canopy at the north entry.
designDecisions.limitation: Vehicle drive and drop-off geometry are not modeled.

designDecisions.decision: Applied coordinated ivory, limestone, bronze, and timber elements with deep roof edges and an articulated entrance.
designDecisions.limitation: Materials are scene-material representations, not product specifications or workmanship certification.

designDecisions.decision: Used a subordinate hip roof over the private wing while retaining flat roofs over the principal hall and service wing.
designDecisions.limitation: Roof flashing, drainage, uplift resistance, and structural design require separate engineering.

designDecisions.decision: Avoided a generic glass box by combining substantial walls, deep roofs, shaded glazing, a pool terrace, and an open lounge pavilion.
designDecisions.limitation: Landscape, planting, and climate-performance simulation are not available.

designDecisions.decision: Made the living hall the largest and most open volume, stepping the private and service volumes down around it.
designDecisions.limitation: Interior room partitions and furnishings beyond the outdoor lounge/bar elements are not modeled.

designDecisions.decision: Created a broad occupied terrace with a continuous dry route, posts, canopy, direct glazed access, and a pool-facing lounge edge.
designDecisions.limitation: The terrace guard condition is intentionally omitted because it is at ground-level; detailed slip resistance and structural review are not represented.

limitations: Surface areas are per physical element; overlapping surfaces are not additional usable area. Enclosed area, requested-space completeness, pool construction and circulation require architectural review. A renderable model is not a completed building.
